verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs say Insights tracks case resolution as a core metric alongside CSAT, and that the voice agent delivers real-time resolutions, including completing card/ACH payments with no IVR handoff. Outcome-based pricing ties cost to achieved outcomes, and a community commenter describes the product taking over processes that otherwise fall to human support teams. All of this is vendor-claimed or anecdotal, and nothing quantifies the share of conversations actually resolved or separates resolutions from deflections. Missing for 10: published resolution-rate figures or case studies, a definition of how a resolution differs from a deflection, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end resolution.
